name: Painboy

bonuses.name: 'Ere We Go!
bonuses.text: If this Threat is Engaged at the start of its Turn, it gains +2 damage to melee attacks.

bonuses.name: Bionik Boyz
bonuses.text: A number of ORK Threats equal to the Tier of the game that accompany the Painboy may have Bioniks (Wrath & Glory page 246).

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: The Painboy may use Ruin actions and has 1 personal Ruin.

abilities.name: Wetwork
abilities.text: The Painboy uses their Dok's Tools on an ally and makes an attack using one of its weapons, ignoring the Multi-Action DN penalty.

abilities.name: Dok's Tools
abilities.text: The Painboy makes a DN3 Medicae (Int) Test on an ally as a Simple Action. Every shifted Exalted Icon causes the target to recover 1 additional Wound. If The Painboy rolls a Complication, the Test fails, and the target suffers an additional Wound
'Urty Syringe is printed without a Range: "8 +2 ED / Rending (6)".

note: Reprint of painboy; differs in Strength 6 (Core 5), Toughness 6 (4), Wounds 10 (6), Shock 5 (4), Resilience 8 (AR 1) (Core 6), Ballistic Skill 5 added, Defence/Awareness, Champion Ruin 1 (Core 3), no Kwik Fix Ruin, Determination 6d6, and the Tier row (5 Tiers).
